title: OSINT-Resources
description: A categorized directory of OSINT resources with concise usage guidance, tags, suggested use cases, and cautions for responsible verification.

categories.name: General Search
categories.description: Search for publicly available information about people and identities.

resources.name: Addresses.com
resources.description: People-search directory that may help locate publicly listed contact and address information, primarily for U.S.-focused searches.
resources.bestFor: Starting a search for publicly listed address or contact details.
resources.caution: Coverage and accuracy vary. Confirm any match with independent sources; avoid using results to harass or expose private individuals.

resources.name: Epieos
resources.description: OSINT service associated with searching identifiers such as email addresses and usernames for publicly discoverable account-related information.
resources.bestFor: Exploring possible public account associations for an identifier.
resources.caution: A matching result is only a lead, not proof that accounts belong to the same person. Check the site's current features and terms.

resources.name: IDCrawl
resources.description: People-search and social-profile search site that aggregates publicly discoverable profile references across websites.
resources.bestFor: Finding public profile pages that may be associated with a name or handle.
resources.caution: Aggregated results can be outdated or refer to different people; verify each result independently.

resources.name: OSINT Industries
resources.description: OSINT search platform for exploring publicly available information connected to identifiers such as email addresses, usernames, or phone numbers; available features may depend on its current offering.
resources.bestFor: Pivoting from a known identifier to possible public references.
resources.caution: Check current access requirements, pricing, and terms. Treat associations as unverified leads.

resources.name: That'sThem
resources.description: People-search directory that can surface publicly listed contact, location, and related records, with coverage focused largely on the United States.
resources.bestFor: Checking whether publicly listed U.S. contact details appear in directory results.
resources.caution: Results may be incomplete, stale, or mismatched. Respect applicable privacy laws and site terms.

resources.name: USA People Search
resources.description: U.S.-oriented people-search directory for looking up publicly listed names, locations, and possible contact or record references.
resources.bestFor: Searching public directory information about a U.S.-based person.
resources.caution: Do not treat directory matches as verified identity. Review the provider's privacy practices and applicable legal restrictions.

resources.name: Whitepages
resources.description: People-search and directory service that may provide publicly listed names, phone numbers, addresses, and related U.S. directory information.
resources.bestFor: Checking publicly listed U.S. contact or directory information.
resources.caution: Some details or features may require payment. Validate results with authoritative or independent sources.

categories.name: Username Only
categories.description: Tools focused on finding accounts associated with a username.

resources.name: WhatsMyName
resources.description: Username-search tool that checks many supported websites for profile pages matching a supplied handle.
resources.bestFor: Finding candidate public profiles that use the same username across supported sites.
resources.caution: A reused handle does not establish that profiles belong to one person; inspect each result and account context.

categories.name: Email Only
categories.description: Tools for checking email addresses and related exposure.

resources.name: Have I Been Pwned
resources.description: Breach-notification service for checking whether an email address appears in known data breaches and reviewing related exposure information.
resources.bestFor: Checking an address you own or are authorized to assess for known breach exposure.
resources.caution: A result does not reveal every possible compromise, and no result does not guarantee an account is safe. Never enter passwords into untrusted sites.

categories.name: Phone Number Only
categories.description: Tools for validating or researching phone numbers.

resources.name: PhoneValidator
resources.description: Phone-number lookup and validation service that may provide number-format, line-type, carrier, or location-related information depending on coverage.
resources.bestFor: Checking whether a phone number is formatted plausibly and reviewing available line details.
resources.caution: Number portability, VoIP services, and regional coverage can make carrier or location information inaccurate.

resources.name: WhoCalled
resources.description: Phone-number lookup and caller-report directory that can help review public reports associated with a number.
resources.bestFor: Reviewing community reports about an unfamiliar caller.
resources.caution: User-submitted reports can be wrong or malicious; do not treat them as verified claims about a person.

categories.name: Website
categories.description: Tools for researching domains and websites.

resources.name: DomainTools WHOIS
resources.description: WHOIS lookup interface for reviewing available domain-registration data, such as registrar, registration dates, and nameservers.
resources.bestFor: Gathering registration details and basic context about a domain.
resources.caution: Privacy protection, registry policies, and newer registration systems can hide or limit registrant details.

categories.name: IP Loggers
categories.description: IP-logging links and services; use only with informed consent and lawful authorization.

resources.name: Grabify
resources.description: Link-generation service that can log connection metadata, potentially including an IP address, when someone opens a generated link.
resources.bestFor: Authorized testing or transparent link analytics where visitors understand what is collected.
resources.caution: Use only with informed consent and lawful authorization. IP addresses are sensitive metadata and do not reliably identify a person or precise location.

resources.name: IPLogger
resources.description: Link and pixel logging service that may record connection metadata when a tracked resource is accessed.
resources.bestFor: Authorized diagnostics or consent-based analytics.
resources.caution: Use only with informed consent and lawful authorization. Do not use tracking links to deceive, stalk, or expose people.

categories.name: Reverse Image Search
categories.description: Tools for searching for visually similar or matching images.

resources.name: Bing Images
resources.description: Bing Images search, which supports searching for visually similar images and finding pages where images appear.
resources.bestFor: Finding visually similar images and possible source pages.
resources.caution: Results depend on indexing and can miss matches. Similar imagery alone does not prove that two images depict the same person or event.

resources.name: Google Search (image search)
resources.description: Google image-search entry point for discovering visually similar images and webpages containing related imagery.
resources.bestFor: Looking for copies, visually related images, or pages associated with an image.
resources.caution: Search features and URL parameters may change; verify results at the destination site.

resources.name: PimEyes
resources.description: Face-search service designed to find web images that may contain a similar face.
resources.bestFor: Finding candidate web-image matches for a face in contexts where use is lawful and appropriate.
resources.caution: Face matches can be false positives and are not identity verification. Consider consent, privacy, and local laws before submitting face images.

resources.name: Yandex Images
resources.description: Yandex Images search for finding visually similar images and webpages associated with image content.
resources.bestFor: Cross-checking an image with a second image-search engine.
resources.caution: Coverage differs across search engines; corroborate findings with other evidence and original sources.

categories.name: Criminal Search
categories.description: Public criminal, custody, and offender-record search resources.

resources.name: Federal Bureau of Prisons Inmate Locator
resources.description: Official U.S. Federal Bureau of Prisons inmate locator for searching federal inmates within the scope described by the agency.
resources.bestFor: Checking federal Bureau of Prisons custody records using the agency's supported search fields.
resources.caution: It does not cover every jail, state prison, or historical record. Use official jurisdictional sources and verify identifiers carefully.

resources.name: Family Watchdog
resources.description: Public-facing site for searching sex-offender registry information by location and related criteria in supported areas.
resources.bestFor: Finding registry references that can then be checked against official state or jurisdictional sources.
resources.caution: Confirm any result with the official registry. Never use registry information to threaten, harass, or unlawfully discriminate against someone.

resources.name: Mugshots.com
resources.description: Third-party site that publishes arrest-related booking photographs or records where available.
resources.bestFor: Locating a possible arrest-record reference for further verification.
resources.caution: An arrest is not a conviction, and third-party records may be incomplete, outdated, or misattributed. Prefer official court or agency records.

resources.name: National Sex Offender Public Website
resources.description: The U.S. Department of Justice's national search portal for participating public sex-offender registry records.
resources.bestFor: Searching participating U.S. jurisdictions and following through to relevant registry information.
resources.caution: Coverage and update timing depend on participating jurisdictions. Verify details with the linked official registry and follow applicable laws.

categories.name: Malware Analysis
categories.description: Services for inspecting suspicious files, URLs, and indicators.

resources.name: ANY.RUN
resources.description: Interactive malware-analysis sandbox for observing the behavior of suspicious files or URLs in an isolated analysis environment.
resources.bestFor: Inspecting suspicious samples in a controlled environment as part of authorized security analysis.
resources.caution: Do not upload confidential or sensitive files unless you understand the service's sharing and retention policies. Never execute suspicious samples on your everyday device.

resources.name: VirusTotal
resources.description: Service that aggregates security-vendor detections and other analysis signals for files, URLs, domains, and IP addresses.
resources.bestFor: Checking whether security vendors or community signals flag a file or indicator.
resources.caution: Detection results can be false positives or false negatives. Submissions may be shared with security partners or the community; review privacy terms before uploading sensitive material.

categories.name: Xbox
categories.description: Resources related to Xbox profiles and gaming identities.

resources.name: GamerDVR
resources.description: Xbox-related community service for finding or viewing gaming clips and profile-related content where available.
resources.bestFor: Looking for publicly accessible gaming clips or profile-related references.
resources.caution: Availability depends on account privacy settings and service support. Do not assume a profile or clip proves a real-world identity.

resources.name: XResolver
resources.description: Third-party gaming-related lookup service associated with resolving gamer identifiers and network-related records.
resources.bestFor: Understanding publicly described gaming-identifier lookup capabilities for defensive or authorized research.
resources.caution: Use particular care with IP-related data: do not target, harass, or expose players. Results can be inaccurate and may raise privacy or platform-policy concerns.
